prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 3:4 aspect ratio, three women in a single row.

A photograph of THREE women standing side by side in a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, the camera set back so all 3 fit comfortably within the frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, dim torchlight and flickering firelight raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Romanian woman in her late 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, warm fair-olive skin, thick dark straight-edged brows, a heavy black liner smoked out at the outer corners, deep brown shadow blended up to the crease, long dense lashes, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, sculpted contour, a deep red matte lip with a crisp edge, a quiet, serious expression, a distinct two-tone ombre with dark roots and a sharp transition to light ends hair styled in sleek straight, real living eyes. Long coffin nails, chrome finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: painted in Ukrainian Petrykivka floral painting — a black ground with bright red, orange and gold folk-art flowers, wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense folk-art florals filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Left woman's condition: A light smudge of soot marks her cheek and jawline, and a little soot dusts her fingertips, the backs of her hands and her bare feet.

Left woman's restraints: She wears a heavy medieval iron neck ring of wide rough-forged wrought iron, closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, with a heavy iron ring at the front, snug around her neck, from which a heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, runs in a long loose curve across to the neck ring of the woman beside her in the center.

Left woman's pose: standing full height, facing the camera, close beside the other women, the neck chains hanging in long loose curves between them, her hands relaxed at her sides, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.

Left woman's footwear: bare feet flat on the flagstones, with a little soot on the soles and toes.

Center woman: a real adult Chinese woman in her early 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, with the polished look of a C-pop idol, smooth high cheekbones with a gently tapering jaw and a small round chin, large clear almond eyes with a soft double lid, willow-leaf brows, a small nose and small full lips, porcelain-pale skin, slender upswept willow-leaf brows, a fine red floral huadian mark painted on the forehead, softly flushed rosy cheeks, an upswept eyeliner tail, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a small vivid red lip, a calm, composed expression, deep burgundy wine-red hair styled in many small bantu knots covering the scalp, real living eyes. Long stiletto nails, holographic finish.

Center woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. a stunning hourglass figure, far more dramatically curved than any ordinary woman. A full, rounded bust, a dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist with a deep shadowed groove running around her middle, and wide, curvaceous hips flaring well beyond her shoulders, soft rounded thighs, toned but soft arms. Not thin, not androgynous, not boyish, not a straight figure. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's pose: standing full height, facing the camera, close beside the other women, the neck chains hanging in long loose curves between them, her hands relaxed at her sides, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.

Composition: the whole row of women fills the width of the tall frame, each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly.

Skin (all): real photographic skin, visible pores and fine grain, natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, no illustration finish, no CG sheen.

Lighting: the light carving every fold and curve on all 3, catching each woman's own painted pattern distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 vertical portrait 8K, taller than it is wide.
